title: IrtFitAcceptedResponse
description: Body of the 202 of POST /api/v1/analytics/experiments/{experiment_run_id}/fit-irt. The body is bare, not the success envelope.

job_id.description: Scoring job identifier of the form score_<run id>_<unix seconds>_<8 hex>. It embeds the caller-chosen run id, so it is treated as user content; when submitted is false it is the id of an already-active scoring job for the run, not necessarily a fit job.

submitted.description: True when this request started a new job; false when an already-active scoring job for the run was reused.
